[[Chine Gabbard]]'s '''research station''' was located on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], upwind from the [[Vlassy Nature Preserve]]. At this facility, Gabbard [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] [[hala]] pollen to carry [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve agents]].
